scope.scope: Complete 28-table catalogue across statuses, banks, families, releases and current/historical versions: 400 current items, 273 immutable versions, 66 current template guides, 10 skill guides, 159 runtime and 315 authoring guide versions.

readContinuity.method: Reload changed complete tables in deterministic pages; carry only tables with fresh count/hash equality. Bracket the complete reconstruction with 38-table guards.

scope.freshInspection: All 48 current S05/S07/S08 questions with keys/options; their 25 template guides and nine noncurrent item versions; Chapter I S05 experimental-design bank. Earlier same-session whole-Chapter-II and related current/history guide inspection is carried only where complete-table fingerprints match. Eleven changed tables were reloaded in full, including approved Batch 14.
scope.historyBoundary: All immutable, retired and exposed history retained; no inaccessible bank omitted. Repeated claims and procedures qualify only as bounded protected parallel variants, never as independent new reasoning.
scope.sourceRead: Textbook §10 printed pp.30–33 and §11 pp.34–35 checked afresh; Chapter I §3 pp.13–14 checked for experimental reasoning. §9 is the small-object laboratory, not molecular motion.
scope.relatedMappings: Motion, diffusion and temperature claims cross S05/S06/S07/S08. Chapter I S05 supplies experimental reasoning. Complete other-skill catalogues and mappings remain included; current nearest and full historical snapshots are bound below.
scope.author: Codex automated educational judgment; human content, SME and exposure reviews remain pending.

withinBatchPairs.finding: Both read molecular records, but an incomplete spatial history with a crossing lower bound differs from reconciling individual speeds with known temperatures.
withinBatchPairs.decision: Retain both provisionally; no independent coverage, empirical equivalence or allocation approval inferred.

withinBatchPairs.finding: Both reject overinterpretation of incomplete observations. C01 counts necessary crossings; C03 repairs a temperature comparison with mismatched observation durations. No complete stimulus or solution is repeated.
withinBatchPairs.decision: Retain both provisionally; no independent coverage, empirical equivalence or allocation approval inferred.

withinBatchPairs.finding: Both distinguish observations from full history. C01 reasons about unobserved extra crossings; C04 requires positive penetration and continuous solid phase. Different data, answer demand and distractor logic.
withinBatchPairs.decision: Retain both provisionally; no independent coverage, empirical equivalence or allocation approval inferred.

withinBatchPairs.finding: C02 compares individual and characteristic speed levels. C03 tests diffusion experimentally and controls duration; their common warming premise does not supply either complete response.
withinBatchPairs.decision: Retain both provisionally; no independent coverage, empirical equivalence or allocation approval inferred.

withinBatchPairs.finding: C02 reconciles counterordered individual speeds with known temperatures. C04 audits phase histories and positive evidence. No complete scenario or solution overlap.
withinBatchPairs.decision: Retain both provisionally; no independent coverage, empirical equivalence or allocation approval inferred.

withinBatchPairs.finding: Strongest within-batch relation: both concern slow solid diffusion and limitations of short non-detection. Separation and exposure review remain required.
